name: Betamax
what_failed: Sony's superior video format lost to technically inferior VHS in the format war.
why_it_failed: VHS offered longer recording time (critical for movies/sports)
Sony's licensing restrictions limited manufacturer adoption
VHS had broader content availability (rental stores)
Network effects favored the more available format
Sony optimized for quality; market optimized for convenience
assumptions_that_broke: Controlling the standard is more important than growing it
constraints_that_moved: Recording time became the binding constraint
Content availability became more important than hardware quality
resurrection_conditions: Not applicable - format wars are obsolete
Lesson applies to any platform competition
lesson: The technically superior product loses when the inferior product better satisfies the binding constraint. Betamax had better picture; VHS could record a football game. The market chose the football game.
